userStories.title: Consolidate Dual State Systems
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a single source of truth for application state so that debugging is easier and behavior is predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: All state management uses the Store class from store/index.js

userStories.notes: Consolidated: STATE proxy now created in store/index.js, state.js simplified to initialization only. Proxy set handler now captures prevState for proper listener notification. Debug logging via setStoreDebugMode(true). Undo/redo verified working across all annotation types.

userStories.notes: Unified: All coordinate transforms now use viewport singleton (services/viewport.js). Viewport auto-links to STATE and DOM on load. Removed duplicate eventToImageCoords, imageToDisplayCoords, displayToImageCoords, isWithinImageBounds from utilities.js. All call sites in interactions.js, rendering.js, figures.js updated to use viewport.eventToImage(), viewport.imageToDisplay(), viewport.displayToImage(), viewport.isWithinBounds(). Verified working at all zoom levels.
